items.text: Five civilians are killed and eight more are injured in a shootout between Pakistani soldiers and Afghan soldiers at the border. ((AP))
Two Palestinians are killed and a soldier is injured when Israel Defense Forces soldiers open fire on a car speeding toward troops in Hebron, West Bank. ((The Times of Israel))
At least thirteen people are injured in a motorcycle bombing at a café near a police station in Balboa, Cauca Department, Colombia. ((Blu Radio)) ((Infobae))

The Indian civil aviation ministry caps domestic airfares following widespread IndiGo cancellations caused by pilot shortages and operational failures, setting a maximum one-way price of ₹7,500 (US$83.38) for routes up to . ((Reuters))
Twenty-five people are killed, including 21 workers and four tourists, and approximately 50 others are injured in an explosion and fire at a nightclub in Arpora, Goa, India. ((NDTV)) ((DW))
At least 18 people are killed and two others are critically injured when a dinghy carrying migrants sinks off Crete, Greece. ((Greek Reporter))
At least five people are killed and four others are injured when a vehicle explodes outside of a police station in Coahuayana, Michoacán, Mexico. ((DW Español)) ((CTV News))
Australia imposes economic sanctions and travel bans on four Afghan government officials over their involvement in human rights violations, particularly the Taliban's treatment of women. ((Reuters))
Twelve people are killed, including three children, and 13 others are injured in a mass shooting at an unlicensed bar in Saulsville, Gauteng, South Africa. ((AP))
Four protesters are arrested after they threw custard on a display case containing the Crown Jewels in the Tower of London in England. ((DW))
In soccer, Inter Miami defeats the Vancouver Whitecaps 3–1 to win their first MLS Cup title. ((USA Today))
Four protesters are arrested after they threw custard on a display case containing the Crown Jewels in the Tower of London in England. Take Back Power claims responsibility. ((DW))

Four protesters from Take Back Power are arrested after they threw custard on a display case containing the Crown Jewels in the Tower of London in England. ((DW))

At least five people are killed and 12 others are injured in a suspected car bombing terrorist attack when a vehicle explodes outside of a police station in Coahuayana, Michoacán, Mexico. ((BNO News))
